if not (isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon) or logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("Shapes must match")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call))):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0 or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number and not bool")
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ weights
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ weights
    margin = np.minimum(weighted_with - weighted_no, weighted_with - weighted_call)
    keep = margin > tau_filter
    return keep, margin
